messages:
dmitri: Kicking off prod deploy for v3.8.1 in ~10m. Heads-up: canary -> if anything looks off we'll execute the rollback flightdeck. Please ack your ownership and confirm runbook links.

alice: Ack. I'll own latency + errors for the canary window. Watching RUM and traces.

ben: Ack. I'll watch spanner ops and DB tail latencies. If commit rate drops, I'll call abort.

caroline: Release notes pushed to /releases/v3.8.1 and QA flagged the config change for routing. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollback-flightdeck (see section 2.1 emergency pin)

deploy-bot: canary started 3 hosts (host-a, host-b, host-c) — health checks init. Canary window 5m. Reporting to thread.

alice: quick reminder: abort trigger = 3 consecutive 5m windows where p99 latency > 400ms OR error rate > 2%. Also manual abort allowed.

ben: db note: if index rebuild starts > 6m after deploy, roll back immediately. Steps in runbook to flip routing + pin.

alice: pinned rollback command for ops (in case we need fast pin):
```
# pin old model-serving image
kubectl set image deployment/model-serving model=redwood/model:v3.7.9 --namespace=prod
# clear cache on edge nodes
/opt/tools/edge-cache flush --all
```

caroline: added the rollback checklist to the runbook and linked the changelog. Also created a short issue for follow-up on the routing tweak.

dmitri: If we hit abort, preferred path is: 1) pause new traffic (k8s weight -> 0), 2) pin to v3.7.9, 3) clear caches, 4) monitor for 10m, 5) file a quick incident note. We'll use the flightdeck runbook for exact commands.

deploy-bot: Canary health summary @ 2m: host-a ok, host-b degraded (5% errors), host-c ok. ETA check-in in 3m.

alice: seeing the host-b errors now in traces — looks like a misrouted feature flag. Trying a scoped toggle (rolling). If that doesn't help in 90s, we abort.

ben: preparing DB rollback helpers and pin script. Standby to run.

alice: toggle didn't help. Error rate on host-b climbing to 7%. I'm initiating abort.

dmitri: Roger. Executing flightdeck rollback now. Ben/Caroline/Alice, coordinate steps and confirm each sub-step in thread.

caroline: running pinned command now. Patching service weight to previous at ingress.

deploy-bot: Action: set traffic weight host-b -> 0. Action: kubectl set image deployed: model=v3.7.9. Starting rollout reversal.

ben: DB checks running — write throughput back to baseline, no long-running migrations.

alice: clearing edge caches.

deploy-bot: Rollback rollout status: host-a ok, host-b now draining / rollback in progress, host-c ok.

oncall-bot: Incident note created: INCIDENT-2026-234 — roll back v3.8.1 during canary due to feature-flag routing regression. Owner: dmitri.

caroline: confirmed rollback complete. Services back to v3.7.9 across the board. Monitoring looks stable.

dmitri: Thanks all. Postmortem to follow. Filing follow-up ticket for the feature-flag routing test. We'll revise the runbook with the new quick-toggle command. :thumbsup:
